post.title: Where were the FIRST modern Olympics held? 🏅
post.description:
Where were the FIRST modern Olympics held? Guess first — then drop into a marble stadium in April 1896: 14 nations, 241 athletes, 43 events, and no women at all.

What was your first guess? Do share in the comments below.

Sources: olympics.com (Athens 1896), Wikipedia (1896 Summer Olympics; medal table), CBC Sports.
Map data: Natural Earth (public domain) · imagery NASA Blue Marble. Voice: AI (Kokoro).
